title: Test README commands resolve test paths from the wrong cwd
description: The README says to run from repository root but uses npx --prefix without changing cwd, so tests/test-integration.vitest.ts is resolved outside runtime/cli/tests.
scopeProof: Direct comparison of documented cwd and command operands with the live runtime/cli/tests path.

title: CLI Vitest runs before the build that supplies its imported dist
description: The CLI test script starts Vitest before test:legacy builds dist, while validation-engine-coherence.vitest.ts imports runtime/cli/dist/lib/validation/orchestrator.js directly.
scopeProof: Direct comparison of package script order, generated-output import and the generated dist contract.
